page_title: Vespertine: surround and hi-res music player for Mac

summary.name: Vespertine
summary.one_liner: Vespertine is a free, open-source Mac music player for surround and hi-res audio, with a bit-perfect signal path that can be inspected.
use_cases: play SACD and DVD-Video disc images on a Mac
listen to hi-res and DSD files bit-perfect through an external DAC
play surround and Dolby Atmos or TrueHD files on Mac
verify that audio samples are passed through unchanged
play CUE-sheet albums gaplessly from a single file
summary.what_it_does: Vespertine plays surround and hi-res collections on macOS, including SACD and DVD-Video disc images, DSD, DTS CDs, DTS-HD MA, TrueHD and Dolby Atmos files, and Spatial Audio on AirPods. It switches the output device to each file's sample rate and only resamples, using Apple's converter, when the DAC cannot play the native rate. A signal path view lists each step from file to DAC, read back from Core Audio, and shows when something altered the samples. It offers exclusive (hog) mode, integer 32-bit PCM output, optional 16-bit matching, and gapless playback including CUE-sheet albums. A built-in loopback test compares sent samples against a virtual device as a software check. PCM playback was tested up to 384 kHz on a FiiO K11.
notable: Bit-perfect badge shown only when source and device conditions are met, with a signal path view read back from Core Audio
Plays SACD and DVD-Video disc images, DSD, DTS CD and Dolby Atmos/TrueHD files
Built-in loopback test that compares sent samples to a virtual device, labelled as a software check
Remembers preferred DAC and falls back to the best connected output
caveats: Bit-perfect output depends on source format and whether the DAC is exclusive or unshared; volume below 100% on outputs without their own volume control ends bit-perfect playback
PCM tested up to 384 kHz on one DAC only (FiiO K11), so other hardware is not verified
